results.title: Data improves your experience
results.content:
# Germany jump to No. 2 in latest FIBA World Ranking Men, presented by Nike

The FIBA World Ranking, presented by Nike has been updated after the conclusion of the Continental Cups.

MIES (Switzerland) - USA remained the number one country in the FIBA World Ranking Men, which has a new No. 2 as Germany rose one spot after claiming the FIBA EuroBasket 2025 title in spectacular fashion, finishing the tournament as invincible European champions. [...] Last but not least, Jamaica earned a spot in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Americas Qualifiers through the Pre-Qualifiers, going from 107th to 95th place in the process.

For more information about the method used in the calculation of the FIBA World Ranking Men, please refer to the 'How it Works' section.

Click here to view the full FIBA World Ranking Men, presented by Nike.

### Belgium celebrate a top five spot and Nigeria land in top 10 of FIBA World Ranking Women, presented by Nike [...] Paris 2024 Olympic gold medalists USA held onto first place in the world, despite ending up third at the FIBA AmeriCup 2025. The reigning FIBA Basketball World Cup champion, Germany, defeated Türkiye to win their second ever continental crown. Germany swapped places with third-ranked Serbia, who were eliminated in the Round of 16 at EuroBasket.

results.title: FIBA World Ranking for Men presented by NIKE
Serbia, France and Canada locked in a tight race in latest FIBA World Ranking Men, presented by Nike | FIBA Basketball
results.content:
MIES (Switzerland) – Excellence and stability define the top of the FIBA World Ranking Men, presented by Nike, as each of the five highest-ranked teams posted a perfect record in Window 3 of the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Qualifiers.

Behind USA and Germany, the race for third place is now tighter than ever, with Serbia, France and Canada separated by fewer than 1.5 ranking points. [...] In the Americas, Brazil are the highest climbers, moving up to ninth place ahead of Lithuania. They have improved to 6-0 in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Americas Qualifiers after posting two convincing road wins in Window 3.

The last time Brazil were ranked higher than 10th was after the December 31, 2016 update, when they were seventh in the world. [...] The next update of the FIBA World Ranking Men, following Window 4 in August, could see a change on the podium.

Spain edge ahead of Australia for sixth place thanks to the higher Region Factor applied to games played in the European Qualifiers than to those in the Asian Qualifiers, reflecting the differences in typical opponent strength across FIBA regions.
